text:
maria_cs: FYI - OrbitAI wants to move forward with a Private onboarding for their multilingual voice summarizer. Key asks: customer-managed KMS/HSM, PHI redaction in pipeline, SLOs around tail latency (<200ms per short turn), and a staged rollout. Can we align on evaluations and gating? @sam_se @julian_ml @noor_security

sam_se: I'll coordinate. Quick clarifying Qs: expected peak qps? avg audio length? Are they okay with a transcribe-then-summarize flow vs end-to-end?

maria_cs: Peak ~15 qps, averages 10-18s per clip. They will POST WAVs. Prefer transcribe->summarize. Open to Dedicated if we need guaranteed throughput, but privacy preference is Private with customer KMS.

julian_ml: Ops note: for <200ms token latency on short responses we'll need small batch sizes and aggressive prefix KV caching. Recommend two-stage pipeline: lightweight transcriber (small-ctc) + 13B summarizer quantized to int8. For evals: create a PHI-sensitive holdout (300 samples across EN/ES/FR) and a hallucination/factuality probe set.

noor_security: Security checklist: need customer's KMS ARN, confirm whether HSM attestation is required (key wrapping vs enclave). Also require data flow diagram showing where audio/transcripts land, retention windows, and SOC2+PII handling docs before we greenlight Private.

sam_se: I'll provision a preprod private cluster (1 host) to run a perf smoke test once they share samples. Can also compare perf/cost for: a) 2xA10G Dedicated pool vs b) single private host with tuned batching and cache.

julian_ml: Proposed canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 48-72h windows. Monitoring: latency p50/p95, phi_leak_rate, and factuality delta vs baseline. Rollback triggers: p95 latency > 400ms OR phi_leak detected OR factuality drop > 4%. Also automatic fallback to hosted-7b summarizer for degraded traffic paths.

maria_cs: Capture action items: OrbitAI to send 50 sample WAVs + residency/contract notes; Noor to request KMS ARN & compliance checklist; Julian to seed evals + define metrics; Sam to schedule enablement + spin up preprod cluster. Marking as priority: renewal at risk if this slips.

tara_ops: tagging for ops: I'll add a ticket to infra to reserve capacity windows and enable metrics hooks for continuous evaluation. Also note: include webhook retry/backoff guidance in enablement doc.

maria_cs: Thanks all. Sam - please confirm Wed or Thu for the enablement call. Noor - once you have the KMS spec I'll loop legal for contract addendum. :white_check_mark:

sam_se: Wed 10am PT works for me, will send invite and a short integration checklist.

maria_cs: Closing thread for now, will reopen with sample artifacts.
